none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable convex function f:E→ℝ on a second-countable real Hilbert space. A global minimizer x★ exists with ‖x0−x★‖≤R. Strong convexity and convexity of individual sample functions are not assumed.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One oracle call at (x,y) returns (g(x,ω),g(y,ω)) using the same fresh sample for both evaluations. Samples are IID across calls, and E[g(x,ω)]=∇f(x). The sample law and g are hidden; no function values or exact gradients are supplied. The extracted budget counts paired calls with a fixed cap.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StrongGrowthMeanSquaredSmoothConvex.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: execute, Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: Gradient-relative variance: E‖g(x,ω)−∇f(x)‖²≤Γ²‖∇f(x)‖² for every x, with Γ≥0. Together with unbiasedness this gives E‖g(x,ω)‖²≤(1+Γ²)‖∇f(x)‖². This is a second-moment condition, not a pointwise error bound; no additive noise floor is present.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StrongGrowthMeanSquaredSmoothConvex.lean: spec.valid; spec.admissible (unbiasedness, variance integrability and inequality).

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Mean-squared smoothness under the shared sample: E‖g(x,ω)−g(y,ω)‖²≤Lbar²‖x−y‖² for all x,y. No samplewise Lipschitz bound is required. The space may be infinite-dimensional. All Params are public, including Lbar>0, Γ≥0, R≥0, ε>0 and x0; the objective, sampling laws and oracle map remain hidden.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output X whose objective gap f(X)−f(x★) is integrable and at most ε in expectation for a global minimizer x★. No particular iterate or averaging rule is required.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E[f(X)−f(x★)]≤ε, taking expectation over the product of algorithm randomness and the IID oracle-seed law. No high-probability or almost-sure accuracy guarantee is requested.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: A structured stochastic convex variant combining gradient-relative variance, mean-squared oracle smoothness and paired shared-sample queries on a potentially infinite-dimensional Hilbert space.
